Union Pac (UNP) Holder Bristol John W & Company Increased Stake by $21.16 Million as Share Value Declined; St Micro Electronics (STM) Shareholder Lockheed Martin Investment Management Company Has Cut Its Stake as Share Price Rose
April 26, 2018 - By Linda Rogers
Lockheed Martin Investment Management Company decreased its stake in St Micro Electronics (STM) by 26.6% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Lockheed Martin Investment Management Company sold 18,010 shares as the company’s stock rose 2.70% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 49,700 shares of the semiconductors company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $1.09M, down from 67,710 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Lockheed Martin Investment Management Company who had been investing in St Micro Electronics for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $19.32B market cap company. The stock increased 3.19% or $0.68 during the last trading session, reaching $21.99. About 6.85M shares traded or 81.46% up from the average. STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE:STM) has risen 45.26% since April 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 33.71% the S&P500.
Bristol John W & Company Inc increased its stake in Union Pac Corp (UNP) by 32.38% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Bristol John W & Company Inc bought 157,880 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.36% with the market. The institutional investor held 645,532 shares of the railroads company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $86.57 million, up from 487,652 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Bristol John W & Company Inc who had been investing in Union Pac Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $105.53B market cap company. The stock increased 2.43% or $3.23 during the last trading session, reaching $136.06. About 4.72M shares traded. Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE:UNP) has risen 26.23% since April 26, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 14.68% the S&P500.
Lockheed Martin Investment Management Company, which manages about $2.17 billion US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Bank Of America (NYSE:BAC) by 106,600 shares to 150,600 shares, valued at $4.45M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 103,230 shares in the quarter, for a total of 280,970 shares, and has risen its stake in Alibaba Group Hlds Ltd (NYSE:BABA).
Among 12 analysts covering STMicroelectronics ( NYSE:STM ), 7 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 3 Hold. Therefore 58% are positive. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, October 26 by Robert W. Baird. Zacks downgraded STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE:STM) on Wednesday, August 5 to “Hold” rating. Craig Hallum maintained STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE:STM) on Thursday, October 26 with “Buy” rating. The rating was downgraded by Stifel Nicolaus on Monday, May 15 to “Hold”. The stock of STMicroelectronics N.V. (NYSE:STM) earned “Hold” rating by Craig Hallum on Friday, October 30. The rating was maintained by Craig Hallum on Friday, April 28 with “Buy”. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Monday, September 14 by Natixis. The firm has “Hold” rating by HSBC given on Friday, July 24.
